title: CRESt discovers a multielement formate-oxidation catalyst
summary: CRESt combines multimodal models, knowledge-assisted Bayesian optimization and robotic synthesis and testing. Across more than 900 chemistries and 3,500 electrochemical tests, it identified an eight-element catalyst with a reported 9.3-fold improvement in cost-specific formate-oxidation performance. The metric is cost-specific, not a universal activity comparison.
ai_technology: CRESt multimodal model; knowledge-assisted Bayesian optimization

evidence.tested: The source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broader deployment or clinical benefit are not established by this source review.
evidence.ai_role: The model combines composition, literature text embeddings and microstructural images; Bayesian optimization prioritizes experiments and robotic tests feed results back.
